Products.List.Title: Products
Products.List.Subtitle: What the salon keeps on its shelves: what you sell and what you use at the chair.
Products.List.Empty: No products yet. Add the first one and say how many are on the shelf.
Products.List.EmptyForStaff: No products yet. The owner or a manager adds them.
Products.Save.Name: Name
Products.Save.NameHint: Include the size if you stock more than one, for example “Shampoo 250 ml”.
Products.Save.RetailPriceHint: For example 12 or 12.50. Leave empty for a product you only use in the salon.
Products.Save.LowStockAt: Warn when this many are left
Products.Save.LowStockAtHint: The product shows as low at this number or fewer. Leave empty for no warning.
Products.Save.OpeningStockHint: Count them now, or leave empty and add a delivery later.
Products.Save.IsActive: The salon still uses this product
Products.Save.IsActiveHint: Untick to take it off the list. Its history is kept.
Products.Save.Validation.NameTaken: A product with this name already exists.
Products.Save.Validation.Price: Enter a price from 0 to {0}, with at most two decimal places, or leave it empty.
Products.Save.Validation.LowStockAt: Enter a whole number from 0 to {0}, or leave it empty.
Products.Save.Validation.OpeningStock: Enter a whole number from 0 to {0}, or leave it empty.
Products.Card.LowNote: Running low: the warning is set at {0}. Time to reorder.
Products.Card.HistoryEmpty: Nothing has been recorded for this product yet.
Products.Stock.Received.Title: A delivery arrived
Products.Stock.Received.NoteHint: For example the supplier or the invoice number.
Products.Stock.Used.Title: Used in the salon
Products.Stock.Counted.Title: Count the shelf
Products.Stock.Counted.Hint: The record is set to this number and the difference goes in the history.
Products.Stock.WrittenOff.Title: Write off
Products.Stock.WrittenOff.ReasonHint: For example broken, out of date or lost. Kept in the history with your name.
Products.Stock.Recorded.Received.One: {0} unit added. The shelf now holds {1}.
Products.Stock.Recorded.Received.Many: {0} units added. The shelf now holds {1}.
Products.Stock.Recorded.UsedInSalon.One: {0} unit taken off as used. The shelf now holds {1}.
Products.Stock.Recorded.UsedInSalon.Many: {0} units taken off as used. The shelf now holds {1}.
Products.Stock.Recorded.WrittenOff.One: {0} unit written off. The shelf now holds {1}.
Products.Stock.Recorded.WrittenOff.Many: {0} units written off. The shelf now holds {1}.
Products.Stock.Recorded.Counted.One: The count is recorded. It differed by {0} unit; the shelf holds {1}.
Products.Stock.Recorded.Counted.Many: The count is recorded. It differed by {0} units; the shelf holds {1}.
Products.Stock.CountMatches: The count matches the record: {0} on the shelf. Nothing was changed.
Products.Stock.Refused.InvalidNumber: Enter a whole number: 1 or more units, or 0 or more for a count.
Products.Stock.Refused.NoteRequired: Say why the units are written off.
Products.Stock.Refused.NotEnough: The record shows only {0} on the shelf. If there are more, count the shelf first.
Products.Stock.Refused.TooMany: That is more than a shelf can hold on record.
Products.Stock.Refused.ChangedMeanwhile: Someone else changed this shelf at the same moment. Nothing was recorded. The shelf holds {0}; check and try again.
